# NishimoriMulticriticalBoundary

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A boundary criticality phenomenon at the multicritical point of the Nishimori line in disordered spin systems, where bulk and surface transitions coincide. Provides a theoretical framework for understanding robustness of topological order under disorder, critical for reliable TCC device operation.
